title: POST /devices/enroll – 200 response
description: The new device, its token (device ability) and its HMAC secret. Token and secret are returned only by this response: no other endpoint returns them, and only a replay of this request with the same Idempotency-Key within 24 hours returns them again (see common/idempotency-key.json). Error responses use api/error.json.

token.description: Bearer token of the device. Opaque; store it in the secure store.

secret.description: 32 random bytes, base64: the HMAC-SHA256 key of the device's chain. Store it in the secure store.
